compare_prefix32k_row18554_boundaries_r1.text:
"""Compare original selected-row traces to history-qualified GB10 observations."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import struct
import sys

B = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
native = B / (sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'prefix32k-row18554-boundaries-r1')
reference = B / 'qrt-gb10-prefix32k-row18554-20260912-r1' / 'capture'
case = 'long-prefix32768-owner-out32'
capture = json.loads((reference / (case + '.json')).read_text())
runtime = capture['worker']['runtime_boundaries']
txn = runtime['transactions'][2]
position = 18554
selected = [i for i, row in enumerate(txn['qualified_rows'])
            if row['position'] == position and row['matches_generated_history']]
assert len(selected) == 1 and txn['ordinal'] == 2 and txn['first_position'] == 16384
selected = selected[0]
traces = []
for line in (native / 'product.stderr.log').read_text().splitlines():
    if 'BATCH_MARK qwen36_exact_arbitrary_' not in line or ' f32_bits=' not in line:
        continue
    fields = dict(re.findall(r'(\w+)=([^\s]+)', line))
    if fields.get('prefill_tokens') != '32768':
        continue
    assert int(fields.get('trace_position', fields.get('terminal_position', -1))) == position
    fields['bits'] = [int(x, 16) for x in fields.pop('f32_bits').split(',')]
    fields['marker'] = line.split()[1]
    traces.append(fields)

def f32(bits):
    return struct.unpack('<f', struct.pack('<I', bits))[0]

def bf16(bits):
    return ((bits + 0x7fff + ((bits >> 16) & 1)) >> 16) & 65535

def compare(trace, key, ref_start=0, count=None):
    meta = runtime['files'][key]
    data = (reference / case / meta['file']).read_bytes()
    assert len(data) == meta['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == meta['sha256']
    assert meta['shape'][0] == len(txn['qualified_rows']) and len(meta['shape']) == 2
    all_ref = ([x[0] << 16 for x in struct.iter_unpack('<H', data)]
               if meta['dtype'] == 'bf16' else [x[0] for x in struct.iter_unpack('<I', data)])
    width = meta['shape'][1]
    ref = all_ref[selected * width:(selected + 1) * width]
    ref = ref[ref_start:ref_start + count] if count is not None else ref[ref_start:]
    got = trace['bits']
    assert len(got) == len(ref), (key, len(got), len(ref))
    ga, ra = [bf16(x) for x in got], [bf16(x) for x in ref]
    diffs = [i for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(ga, ra)) if a != b]
    return dict(native={k: v for k, v in trace.items() if k != 'bits'},
                reference=meta, reference_selected_row=selected, reference_slice_start=ref_start,
                elements=len(got), raw_bit_mismatches=sum(a != b for a, b in zip(got, ref)),
                bf16_rne_mismatches=len(diffs),
                max_abs_error=max(abs(f32(a)-f32(b)) for a, b in zip(got, ref)),
                bf16_max_abs_error=max(abs(f32(a << 16)-f32(b << 16)) for a, b in zip(ga, ra)),
                first_bf16_mismatches=[dict(index=i, native=f32(ga[i] << 16),
                    reference=f32(ra[i] << 16), native_bits=f'{got[i]:08x}',
                    reference_bits=f'{ref[i]:08x}') for i in diffs[:8]])

boundary = dict(input_rmsnorm='input-rmsnorm-bf16',
                post_attention_rmsnorm='post-attention-rmsnorm-bf16',
                post_attention_hidden='residual-bf16')
attention = dict(full_attention_q_norm_rope='q-rope-bf16',
                 full_attention_k_norm_rope='k-rope-bf16',
                 full_attention_context='context-bf16',
                 full_attention_gated_context='gated-bf16',
                 full_attention_o_projection='output-bf16')
rows = []
unpaired = []
for trace in traces:
    marker, surface, layer = trace['marker'], trace.get('surface'), int(trace['layer'])
    prefix = f'txn0002-layer-{layer:02d}-'
    if marker.endswith('layer_output_trace'):
        rows.append(compare(trace, prefix + 'combined-f32'))
    elif marker.endswith('layer_boundary_trace') and surface in boundary:
        rows.append(compare(trace, prefix + boundary[surface]))
    elif surface == 'seed_hidden' and layer > 0:
        rows.append(compare(trace, f'txn0002-layer-{layer - 1:02d}-combined-f32'))
    elif surface == 'full_attention_input_rmsnorm':
        rows.append(compare(trace, prefix + 'input-rmsnorm-bf16'))
    elif surface in attention:
        rows.append(compare(trace, f'txn0002-full-{layer:02d}-' + attention[surface]))
    elif surface in ('full_attention_q_projection', 'full_attention_k_projection',
                     'full_attention_v_projection', 'full_attention_v'):
        start, count = ((0, 8192) if surface == 'full_attention_q_projection' else
                        (8192, 512) if surface == 'full_attention_k_projection' else (8704, 512))
        rows.append(compare(trace, f'txn0002-full-{layer:02d}-qkv-bf16', start, count))
    else:
        unpaired.append({k: v for k, v in trace.items() if k != 'bits'})
assert len(rows) >= 13
record = dict(diagnostic_only=True, inference_acceptance=False, host='baiying',
              reference_host='aitopatom-66c4', model='D:\\models\\Qwen3.6-35B-A3B',
              position=position, prompt_tokens=32768, reference_transaction=2,
              native_run_record_sha256=hashlib.sha256((native/'run-record.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              native_log_sha256=hashlib.sha256((native/'product.stderr.log').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              reference_case_sha256=hashlib.sha256((reference/(case+'.json')).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              reference_row=txn['qualified_rows'][selected], comparisons=rows, unpaired=unpaired)
(native/'row-boundary-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n')
for row in rows:
    print(row['native'].get('surface', 'combined'), row['native']['layer'],
          row['bf16_rne_mismatches'], '/', row['elements'], 'max', row['bf16_max_abs_error'])

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import socket
import struct

assert socket.gethostname() == 'aitopatom-66c4'
root = Path('<private-home>/prefix32k-row18554-projection-r1')
root.mkdir()
model = Path('/mnt/data/models/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B')
capture_root = Path('<private-home>/qrt-gb10-prefix32k-row18554-20260912-r1')
capture = json.loads((capture_root/'capture/capture.json').read_text())
data = (model/'model.safetensors.index.json').read_bytes()
sha = lambda value: hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
assert sha(data) == capture['model_evidence']['index_sha256']
key = 'model.language_model.layers.11.self_attn.o_proj.weight'
shard = json.loads(data)['weight_map'][key]
with (model/shard).open('rb') as handle:
    header_size = struct.unpack('<Q', handle.read(8))[0]
    assert header_size < 16 << 20
    entry = json.loads(handle.read(header_size))[key]
    assert entry['dtype'] == 'BF16' and entry['shape'] == [2048, 4096]
    first, last = entry['data_offsets']
    offset = 8 + header_size + first
    handle.seek(offset)
    weights = handle.read(last - first)
assert len(weights) == 2048 * 4096 * 2
(root/'o_proj.bin').write_bytes(weights)
record = dict(host=socket.gethostname(), model=str(model), model_index_sha256=sha(data),
              source_commit='730a85518bd98f2b4d672fc91427121c51ff473e',
              command_file=__file__, command_file_sha256=sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
              key=key, shard=shard, offset=offset, shape=entry['shape'],
              dtype='bf16', file='o_proj.bin', bytes=len(weights), sha256=sha(weights),
              reference_capture_sha256=sha((capture_root/'capture/capture.json').read_bytes()),
              diagnostic_only=True, inference_acceptance=False)
